images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference of a fantasy town BLACKSMITH SHOP, a single building game asset. Reference image is MATERIAL AND ART STYLE ONLY: retain warm honey-brown round interlocking log walls, charcoal-gray shingle roofs, restrained green shutters, hand-crafted wood and gray stone; this is a NEW blacksmith building, not the reference cabin. DESIGN: asymmetrical compact one-storey rectangular enclosed shop on LEFT/west, simple east-west ridge gabled roof with no dormers or tower. Main front/south wall has ONE green-shuttered window left of ONE wooden door. One small hanging sign with an anvil silhouette (no lettering) near the door. On RIGHT/east attach a HALF-OPEN smithing bay under a lower single-slope lean-to shingle roof supported by two front timber posts. The work bay is open to SOUTH/front and EAST/right, closed by a gray stone rear/north wall. ONE square masonry forge is against the REAR of this bay, with ONE tall gray stone chimney rising through its lean-to roof at the northeast corner. A small unlit forge opening, no smoke. ONE iron anvil on a thick wooden stump is centered in the bay, one hammer on the anvil. ONE round wooden water tub near front-right bay corner. ONE simple wooden rack holding three basic straight swords stands along the bay's enclosed-shop-side wall; ONE ore crate and ONE coal basket tucked near the forge. Building stands on a low stone slab with one shallow doorstep, not a tall stilt deck. Rear shop wall: two small matching green-shuttered windows, no door. West/left side wall: one green-shuttered window. Rear work-bay wall is solid stone. No extra porch, fences, chairs, trees, landscape, characters, text or dimensions. Realistic stylized 3D asset presentation, neutral-gray seamless studio background, even soft diffuse light, minimal shadows, no flare, crisp readable structural details, no watermarks. Entire building plus all props fit comfortably inside frame with generous margins. Landscape 16:9 image, single full-building view, never a collage. CAMERA: Front-right three-quarter view from SOUTHEAST, viewing the front doorway and open east workshop. Camera elevation 15 degrees, long focal length. Enclosed cottage is image LEFT, open workshop is near image RIGHT. Show the forge, anvil, water tub and rack clearly.
